messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: Application failed to load
parts:
I had my application up and running without any issues.  This morning when I tried going to the app it was failing to load, so I tried deploying the application, again.  Now I am getting the following error:

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Error: /v1/applications/10007/deploy 409 - 1 task(s) in progress

I am using the same code I used to originally deploy the app.  Do you have any ideas what may be causing this?

Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Application failed to load
parts:
Josh,

It looks like you were trying to deploy your application as I was releasing a bug fix for ShinyApps service. This can cause this error you are getting, which requires manual intervention on my part. I've gone ahead and corrected the problem, and also re-deployed your application. So you should be all set. Sorry for trouble.


-Andy
